frequency_question: How often does a federal oversight review of a major professional accrediting body result in formal revocation of its recognition within a specific multi-year window?
membership_rule: Includes formal agency recognition review proceedings initiated by a federal department against national or specialized professional accrediting bodies. Excludes voluntary relinquishments of accreditation status without adverse federal enforcement orders.

coverage_note: 3 named; representing the primary contested professional and institutional accrediting review cases in recent decades.
known_gaps: Excludes minor institutional accrediting bodies that faced quiet administrative termination without high-profile public contestation.
skeleton: Federal recognition review cycles for major professional or institutional accrediting agencies since 1990, resulting in final revocation versus renewal or probation.
multiplier: 3 major contentious review cycles evaluated; 1 resulted in ultimate revocation (ACICS), 2 resulted in corrective action/probation and retention (ABA historical episodes).
validity_reason: Statutory and regulatory standards governing federal recognition of accrediting agencies remain stable across this horizon, though political shifts can alter enforcement posture.
